"Citizen Alexandra is a story driven by a female protagonist. The supreme guardian can also show her warm and vulnerable sides. "Although in this play, Alexandra will reveal her female elegance and a unique charm, she is always the Supreme Guardian in her people's hearts, which means she had to change. Catherine said with a smile that she was very grateful for the trust of the director and producer in letting her decide the female lead. The cooperation between Meeya the director and Catherine the composer was a surprising success. The play Citizen Alexandra had not been shown to the public, but in the previous trial shows that only opened to professionals and the media, this musical combining many popular songs was greatly praised by the audience. "Blizzards may tear me apart but can also make me who I am. It's your love that help my heart always be as unbreakable as a rock."
